title: Finite quasi-compact jointly surjective pullbacks detect abelian sheaf morphisms
statement: Let $U$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $I$ be a finite set, and let $g_i:Z_i\to U$ be quasi-compact scheme morphisms [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] whose images cover $|U|$. For abelian sheaves $F,G$ on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and a sheaf morphism $\varphi:F\to G$, if $g_i^{-1}(\varphi)=0$ for every $i\in I$, where inverse image is [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], then $\varphi=0$. No weak-etaleness hypothesis is imposed on the $g_i$. The empty family is allowed when $U$ is empty.
